title: Where Planning Changes the Outcome of Orbital Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.37686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces OrbitalGym, a simulation environment for studying when planning algorithms or system design determine the outcome of adversarial orbital encounters. In an orbital game, two non-cooperative teams of satellites maneuver during rendezvous and proximity operations to win a differential-reward objective. Advances in terrestrial game playing have prompted many methods for orbital games, but studies typically evaluate one method in one scenario, often against a passive or random defender. It is unclear whether better planning matters once vehicle capability (maneuverability, sensing, communications) and adversarial responses are considered.   OrbitalGym is a JAX-based environment supporting varying numbers of agents, state representations (position, velocity, attitude, fuel), explicit or implicit communication, and proximity or conical field-of-view sensors. translated_title: 规划何时改变轨道博弈的结果
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了OrbitalGym，一个用于研究规划算法或系统设计何时决定对抗性轨道交会胜负的仿真环境。在轨道博弈中，两支互不合作的卫星队伍在交会与接近操作（RPO）过程中进行机动，以争夺基于差异化奖励的目标。地面博弈研究的进展催生了多种轨道博弈方法，但现有研究通常只在单一场景中评估单一方法，且对手往往是被动或随机的防御方。因此，在考虑飞行器能力（机动性、感知、通信）以及对手应对策略之后，更优的规划是否仍然重要尚不明确。OrbitalGym是一个基于JAX的环境，支持数量可变的智能体、多种状态表示（位置、速度、姿态、燃料）、显式或隐式通信，以及接近式或锥形视场传感器。它将博弈编译为批量化的GPU代码，从而支持大规模并行仿真。
tldr: 本文提出基于JAX的大规模并行仿真环境OrbitalGym，用于系统评估在考虑机动、感知、通信等飞行器能力与对手应对时，规划算法和系统设计何时决定对抗性轨道博弈的胜负。
en_tdlr: OrbitalGym is a JAX-based simulation environment that enables large-scale parallel evaluation of when planning algorithms and vehicle system design determine the outcome of adversarial orbital games.
